mechanism_progress: Proved exact spherical-power radialization K_k^m=sum_r P(R_m=r)K_r and its Poissonized continuous-time form. Separately proved canonical stabilizer-orbit lumping for every vertex-transitive graph: the full point-start TV curve, likelihood ratio, every f-divergence, and information varentropy are exactly those of the stabilizer-orbit quotient chain.
obstruction_removed: The previous need to guess an external factor/conditional decomposition is removed: transitivity itself supplies a canonical exact information-preserving quotient. The quotient has gap at least the original gap, at most d outgoing orbit types per state, transition probabilities in multiples of 1/d, and adjacent stationary-mass ratios in [1/d,d].
remaining_obstruction: The stabilizer quotient can still have rank of order n (in particular for a regular action), so transitivity plus a spectral gap has not yet been converted into quotient varentropy concentration. A general proof must control this quotient dynamics, not raw ambient heat-kernel/NBRW chi-square.
partner_boundary: P26's newest checked report proves a shell/Green transfer and the pure exact-distance-two case. This run does not duplicate k=2; the new source-level class is k>=3 and the quotient reduction is transitivity-specific.

sanity_check.scope: exact polynomial radial-mixture identities for d in {3,4,6,8}, k in {2,3,4}, m<=5; exact d=6,k=3 constants; exact full-vs-orbit TV equality on Q3
